movelist.name: Heal Block
movelist.effect: Until the end of the encounter, the target may not gain Hit Points or Temporary Hit Points from any source. This effect ends if the target is switched out or Takes a Breather.

movelist.name: Miracle Eye
movelist.effect: Miracle Eye may be activated as a Swift Action on the user’s turn. For the rest of the turn, the user’s Psychic-Type Moves can hit and affect Dark-Type targets, and the user can see through the Illusion Ability, Moves with the Illusion keyword, and effects created by the Illusionist Capability, ignoring all effects from those.

movelist.name: Growl
movelist.effect: Growl lowers all Legal Targets Attack 1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Telepathy
abilities.effect: The user gains +1 Evasion. Whenever an Ally uses a damaging area-of-effect attack that would hit you, you may Disengage as a Free Action before the attack resolves.

abilities.name: Analytic
abilities.effect: Whenever the user targets uses a damaging Move on a Pokémon or Trainer that has acted before it during Initiative this Round, that Move deals an additional +5 Damage.
